title: Neural Fidelity Calibration for Informative Sim-to-Real Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2504.08604v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning can seamlessly transfer agile locomotion and navigation skills from the simulator to real world. However, bridging the sim-to-real gap with domain randomization or adversarial methods often demands expert physics knowledge to ensure policy robustness. Even so, cutting-edge simulators may fall short of capturing every real-world detail, and the reconstructed environment may introduce errors due to various perception uncertainties. To address these challenges, we propose Neural Fidelity Calibration (NFC), a novel framework that employs conditional score-based diffusion models to calibrate simulator physical coefficients and residual fidelity domains online during robot execution. translated_title: 面向信息丰富的仿真到现实迁移的神经保真度校准
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习能够将敏捷的运动与导航技能从仿真器无缝迁移到真实世界。然而，利用域随机化或对抗方法来弥合仿真到现实的差距，通常需要专家级的物理知识来确保策略的鲁棒性。即便如此，最先进的仿真器也可能无法捕捉现实世界的每一个细节，且重建的环境可能因各种感知不确定性而引入误差。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了神经保真度校准（Neural Fidelity Calibration, NFC），这是一个新颖的框架，利用条件得分扩散模型在机器人执行过程中在线校准仿真器的物理参数和残差保真度域。具体而言，残差保真度反映了仿真模型相对于真实世界动力学的偏移，并捕捉了感知环境的不确定性，使我们能够在推断过程中采样真实的环境。
tldr: 提出神经保真度校准（NFC）框架，利用条件得分扩散模型在机器人运行时在线校准仿真器物理参数与残差保真度域，从而无需专家物理知识即可弥合仿真到现实的差距并捕捉环境不确定性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Neural Fidelity Calibration (NFC), a novel framework using conditional score-based diffusion models to online calibrate simulator physical coefficients and residual fidelity domains during robot execution, bridging the sim-to-real gap and capturing environment uncertainty without requiring expert physics knowledge.
